articles.title: Ilhan Omar hit with unknown spray and other key moments from chaotic Minneapolis town hall
articles.summary: US Congresswoman Ilhan Omar was reportedly hit by an unknown spray during a chaotic town hall event in Minneapolis. This incident, occurring amidst heightened public tensions, raises concerns about the safety of political figures at public gatherings. Details regarding the spray's nature or the perpetrator were not immediately provided, underscoring challenges in maintaining order during such events.

articles.title: Indian and Russian firms launch superjet joint venture
articles.summary: India's Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has formed a joint venture with Russia's UAC to co-manufacture Sukhoi SJ-100 superjets. This collaboration is a significant step in aerospace manufacturing, bolstering India's technological capabilities and industrial base. For SSB aspirants, it highlights India's strategic partnerships and growing self-reliance in aviation, strengthening national security through advanced aerospace production.

articles.title: Dubai Gold District Launches as the Global Epicentre for Gold and Jewellery Trade
articles.summary: Ithra Dubai has officially launched the Dubai Gold District in the United Arab Emirates, marking a landmark moment for the region's gold and jewellery industry. This purpose-built district aims to significantly boost trade, foster innovation, and enhance Dubai's global standing in the precious metals sector. The project is designed to attract businesses and stimulate economic growth, reinforcing Dubai's position as a key international hub for gold and jewellery.

articles.title: Treks through time: Ancient trade routes you can still walk today
articles.summary: Historically, India was traversed by extensive ancient trade routes predating modern transport infrastructure. These routes were crucial conduits, facilitating the exchange of valuable goods like spices, silk, and precious stones, alongside ideas and beliefs, across continents. This highlights India's significant historical connectivity and influence in global commerce and cultural diffusion.

articles.title: FII exposure in Nifty stocks retreats from peak after Rs 1.6 lakh crore exodus in 2025. Where’s money flowing?
articles.summary: Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) have substantially reduced their holdings in large-cap Indian equities. However, this shift is part of a strategic rebalancing, as overseas investors are selectively rotating their capital into mid-cap and small-cap Indian stocks. This trend indicates FIIs are actively seeking new growth opportunities and diversifying their portfolios within the Indian market beyond traditional large-cap investments, reflecting evolving market confidence.

articles.title: Hypersonic Weapons Market to Surpass 8.87 Billion USD by 2025, Forecasting Strong Growth Till 2035
articles.summary: A new "Hypersonic Weapons Market Report 2025-2035" has been released by ResearchAndMarkets.com, detailing the global revenue outlook for this advanced defence technology. The report provides a comprehensive analysis of the projected growth and financial landscape of the hypersonic weapons sector over the next decade. This intelligence is crucial for understanding future trends in military capabilities and investment opportunities within the defence industry.

articles.title: Real Madrid President spoke with Jude Bellingham and other stars about attitude
articles.summary: Real Madrid, under new manager Alvaro Arbeloa, demonstrates strong form with three consecutive victories, boosting their confidence for the crucial final Champions League group game against Benfica. This resurgence, also involving fitness coach Antonio P., highlights tactical and physical improvements crucial for success in elite international club football. Understanding team dynamics and performance indicators is key.
